title: potentilla alpestris var. crocea
intro: Potentilla alpestris var. crocea, commonly known as Alpine Cinquefoil, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, that may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and boost the immune system. Further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and bioactive constituents, but it has been traditionally used to treat various ailments.
